data.summary: Landed as PR #103 (squash d3c5f4d). gitx.CatFiles over one cat-file --batch (CatFile wraps it; missing/short/wrong-OID records are hard errors), gitx.BlobOID with the object format detected once in New, store.ReplayInputFromTree as the single classify/batch/decode reader used by the store and syncer.replayTreeAt, daemon binds socket + writes daemon.json before loading (reads answer the starting placeholder with loaded:false, other reads/writes a retryable 503; a failed first load ends the daemon; Shutdown joins the load; Syncer.Run decides started-vs-stopped under its mutex), client ensureDaemon waits for the socket then for loaded:true under a 30s ceiling naming daemon.log (flock loser exits with code 3 so the CLI keeps polling). Measured on a clone of this ledger: cold load 7.36s -> 35ms, first status succeeds. A high-effort code review's 15 findings were fixed in commits 2-3; the review's fan-out is very token-heavy (~300K+ per run). Not done here, deferred to the next task by its spec: the syncer's other per-blob reads (oneSidedConfirmations etc.) and cache sharing with the store. Deploy of the new binary follows this finish.
